title: Retrieval controls and chunk-level citations in the interface
description: Add a Retrieval section to Settings (default embedding model, reranker toggle), a collapsible Search index panel under the paper's Details tab for power users (profile, state, progress, change model, rebuild), chunk-level citation chips with section headings, and a 'How this answer was found' popover on answers. Keep the composer and thread uncluttered per DESIGN.md.
acceptance_criteria: Given Settings, when choosing a default embedding model, then new papers index with it and local models show install status.
Given a paper's Details tab, when a power user changes the index model, then indexing progress is shown and answers keep working meanwhile.
Given an answer citing two chunks on the same page, when rendered, then both citations are distinguishable and jump to the cited sentence.
Given an answer, when opening 'How this answer was found', then the query, retrieval mode, reranking and passages used are shown.
test_cases: Vitest/RTL component tests; generated OpenAPI types; Playwright updates for citation selectors, the Advanced panel and indexing progress.
verification:
Part 1 (agent E): Settings default search model, paper Search index panel, chat pickers limited to chat models. Part 2 (agent H): answer details, chunk-level chips, reranker choice.
Tests: retrieval-settings.test.tsx; search-index.test.tsx; answer-details.test.tsx; remark-citations.test.ts ('Given the same chunk cited in separate sentences, Then each sentence keeps its chip'); CitationChip.test.tsx.
Browser tests first failed 3 of 12: Markdown chunks never matched the PDF text layer, so citations could not highlight. 422ebb5 converts passages with the GFM parser before matching and renders them in the source dialog (red: expected [] to deeply equal [0, 1, 2]); 12/12 passed afterwards.
Live: switching Attention to Qwen3 4B showed progress (44%, 88%) while OpenAI kept serving; a citation click highlighted the exact supporting sentence on page 4; Details listed query, search, reranking and 16 of 32 passages.
Live (ara-rag-live, real OpenAI key, Attention and RAG papers): see the journal entry 'Wave 3 merge, Wave 4 integration and live verification'.
Review: citation previews fall back to the saved excerpt when re-ingestion replaced the chunk (a58db13). Whole-branch review fixes on 2026-10-09 (journal: 'Whole-branch review and fixes'). Final: backend 802 passed with Ruff clean; frontend check 454 and build pass.
